decisions.reason: Replacing the first eight images does not change the product positioning, target customers, messaging emphasis, or marketing purpose.
The source decision concerns images and does not change the requirement for a client-supplied landing-page video.
The image replacement does not determine or alter the CTA redirect destination or its existing ambiguity.
Replacing images before deployment does not change whether separate hosting or a custom domain is required.
The image replacement decision does not change the exclusion of Shopify as the landing-page platform.
The source changes landing-page imagery but does not alter link distribution, recipient access behavior, or the delivery acceptance condition.
